title: ProjectBlueprint
description: Structured schema for autonomous end-to-end software project generation in AI OS

project_name.description: Unique filesystem-friendly directory name for the project

description.description: Brief architectural overview and functional goals of the project

runtime.description: Primary execution runtime and container environment

files.description: Source code, configuration files, and documentation

path.description: Relative file path from project root (e.g. app/main.py, Dockerfile)

content.description: Complete source code content for the file

description.description: Brief explanation of the file's role

setup_commands.description: Commands to execute for bootstrapping (e.g. npm install)

entrypoint.description: Shell command to run the main project service

test_command.description: Command to run the project's automated test suite
